uncited: **Inputs:** A scalar field defined on an unstructured or rectilinear grid; an isovalue.
**Outputs:** A mesh of bicubic polynomial patches.
Each volume element (cell) contains scalar values at its vertices.
For each cell, evaluate the scalar field at the vertices.
Determine if the isosurface intersects the cell by comparing vertex values to the isovalue.
If an intersection exists, compute the intersection points on the cell edges.
Fit a bicubic polynomial patch to the intersection geometry within the cell.
Output the patch as part of the final surface representation.
Not given in the sources for when not to use.
